La loi libère des conditions de période de cotisation les personnes qui, pendant plus de 12 mois au total au cours du délai-cadre de deux ans, n'étaient pas parties à un rapport de travail pour des motifs précis prévus par la loi (comme une formation si la personne est domiciliée en Suisse depuis dix ans au moins, ou une maladie, un accident ou une maternité sous condition de domicile suisse durant cette période).

claims.claim: During the probation period, there is no statutory protection against dismissal due to illness.
The employment relationship can be terminated at any time during the probation period with a notice period of seven days.

After the probation period, the employee is protected by a statutory waiting period (Sperrfrist) against dismissal if they are unable to work fully or partially due to illness without fault of their own.
The duration of the protection period is 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days from the second to the fifth year of service, and 180 days from the sixth year of service.
A dismissal issued by the employer during an ongoing protection period is null and void (nichtig) and thus legally ineffective.

If the employee was already dismissed before the illness, the dismissal is valid, but the notice period is suspended for the duration of the incapacity to work (up to the end of the protection period) and resumes afterward.

If the employment relationship normally ends on a fixed date (e.g., end of the month), and the end of the continued notice period does not coincide with such a date, the period is extended to the next such date.
